title: Bear Lake to the Tetons
summary: Early start over US-89 past Bear Lake, then the full Grand Teton scenic drive at golden hour.

segments.name: Segment 1 — US-89 to Jackson
segments.blurb: 5am departure over Bear Lake and the Wyoming line into Jackson.

stops.name: Montpelier, Idaho (Butch Cassidy Museum)
stops.note: Bank robbed by Butch Cassidy in 1896.

stops.name: Persephone Bakery (Jackson)
stops.note: Bakery stop in Jackson before the park.

expect.arrive: A 5am start on US-89 through farm country, then Bear Lake's turquoise water comes into view at Garden City; Montpelier is a small Idaho town, Jackson is a proper mountain town with metered downtown parking.

paths.do: Photo stops at overlooks only, no museum or beach time.
Pull off at Bear Lake State Park for 20-30 minutes on the sand.
Bear Lake beach, Butch Cassidy Museum in Montpelier, and a proper coffee/bakery stop in Jackson.

alt: Garden City Utah Bear Lake shoreline

segments.name: Segment 2 — Teton Park Road, Moose to Signal Mountain
segments.blurb: Start of the inner park road, turnout by turnout north from Moose.

stops.name: Craig Thomas Discovery and Visitor Center
stops.q: Craig Thomas Discovery and Visitor Center Grand Teton
stops.note: Park visitor center at Moose entrance.

stops.name: Windy Point Turnout
stops.q: Teton Range from Teton Park Road

stops.name: Teton Glacier Turnout
stops.note: View of the range's largest glacier.

stops.name: Geraldine Lucas Homestead
stops.q: Grand Teton National Park historic homestead
stops.note: Early homesteader's cabin near the road.

stops.name: Mountain View Turnout
stops.q: Teton Range from Teton Park Road

stops.name: Mount Moran Turnout
stops.note: View of Mount Moran's flat-topped summit.

stops.name: Jackson Point Overlook
stops.q: Grand Teton National Park Teton Range panorama

expect.arrive: Teton Park Road turnouts are all direct pull-offs, most with room for 5-15 cars; the Teton Range comes into full view starting at Windy Point and stays in frame the rest of the drive.
expect.parking: Small paved turnouts at each named stop; none have ever been reported full, they're too brief a stop for that.

paths.opt: Drive it, stop for photos only
paths.do: Pull into 3-4 of the best turnouts (Windy Point, Mount Moran, Jackson Point) without getting out for long.
Same turnouts plus 30-40 minutes inside Craig Thomas Discovery and Visitor Center.
All eight turnouts and the homestead, a few minutes at each.

segments.name: Segment 3 — Signal Mountain and Jackson Lake
segments.blurb: Jackson Lake shoreline turnouts and the dam overlook.

stops.name: Emma Matilda Overlook
stops.note: Named for an early park visitor.

stops.name: Signal Mountain Summit Overlook
stops.note: Short side road, highest overlook on the drive.

stops.name: Oxbow Bend Turnout
stops.note: Snake River bend, Mount Moran reflection, wildlife.

stops.name: Moran Entrance Station
stops.q: Grand Teton National Park entrance sign

expect.arrive: Jackson Lake turnouts line the shoreline; Signal Mountain Summit Overlook is a few minutes' detour up a paved side road, the rest are direct roadside pull-offs.

paths.do: Skip the Signal Mountain side road, stop at the lakeside overlooks and the dam.
Detour up Signal Mountain Summit Road for the highest view on the drive.

segments.name: Segment 4 — Highway 89, Snake River overlooks to Mormon Row
segments.blurb: Sunset run down the valley to the historic Mormon Row barns.

stops.name: Snake River Overlook
stops.note: Ansel Adams' famous vantage over the Snake River.

stops.name: Schwabacher Landing
stops.note: Beaver pond reflections of the Teton Range.

stops.name: Glacier View Turnout
stops.q: Teton Range from Teton Park Road

expect.arrive: This is the golden-hour run down the valley; Snake River Overlook and Schwabacher Landing are both short walks from small gravel lots that get busy right at sunset, Mormon Row's barns are visible from the parking areas.
expect.parking: Snake River Overlook has about 16 spaces, Schwabacher Landing about 20 — both fill in the last hour before sunset in good weather.

paths.do: Snake River Overlook and the Moulton Barn at Mormon Row only.
Same two plus the short walk in to Schwabacher Landing's beaver ponds.
All named stops including Teton Point, Glacier View, and Blacktail Ponds.
